name: Standard Single Vision
description: Basic lenses for correcting nearsightedness or farsightedness.

name: Thin & Light High-Index
description: Thinner and lighter lenses, ideal for stronger prescriptions.
use_case: Users with moderate to high prescriptions who want a more aesthetic look.

name: Standard Progressive
description: Multifocal lenses with a seamless progression between distance, intermediate, and near vision.
use_case: First-time progressive lens wearers or those with a presbyopia diagnosis.

name: Premium Digital Progressive
description: Advanced progressive lenses with wider viewing zones and reduced distortion.
use_case: Experienced progressive wearers or those who want the best visual experience.

name: Computer/Office Lenses
description: Specialized lenses designed to reduce eye strain for intermediate and near-vision tasks.
use_case: Professionals, students, or anyone spending more than 4 hours a day on a computer.

name: Anti-Reflective Coating
description: Reduces reflections from the front and back of your lenses.
use_case: Essential for all glasses-wearers, especially for night driving and computer use.

name: Blue Light Filtering
description: Filters a portion of the blue-violet light emitted from digital screens.
features: May help reduce digital eye strain
Slight yellow tint may be visible
use_case: Heavy users of digital devices (computers, smartphones, tablets).

name: Transitions® Light-Adaptive
description: Lenses that automatically darken when exposed to UV light.
features: Convenience of glasses and sunglasses in one
use_case: Users who frequently move between indoor and outdoor environments.

name: Polarized Sun Lenses
description: Sunglass lenses that eliminate glare from reflective surfaces like water and roads.
features: Ideal for water sports and outdoor activities
use_case: Anyone looking for premium sunglasses for outdoor activities and driving.
